title: Happy jellyfish
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bellGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD1FF'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FF7AE0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C94FD4'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tentacleGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF9AEA'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7C4DFF'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='38' ry='34' fill='#FF7AE0' opacity='0.12'/>

  <!-- Tentacles -->
  <path d='M32 55 Q28 68 33 80 Q36 88 30 94' stroke='url(#tentacleGrad)' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 58 Q36 72 41 84 Q44 92 39 98' stroke='url(#tentacleGrad)' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 60 Q50 74 48 86 Q47 94 50 99' stroke='url(#tentacleGrad)' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 58 Q64 72 59 84 Q56 92 61 98' stroke='url(#tentacleGrad)' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 55 Q72 68 67 80 Q64 88 70 94' stroke='url(#tentacleGrad)' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Frilly under-edge of bell -->
  <path d='M22 50 Q26 58 32 52 Q38 60 44 52 Q50 60 56 52 Q62 60 68 52 Q74 58 78 50' fill='#E86AD0' stroke='#FFB8F0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Jellyfish bell -->
  <path d='M20 50 Q20 28 50 22 Q80 28 80 50 Q74 54 68 50 Q62 56 56 50 Q50 56 44 50 Q38 56 32 50 Q26 54 20 50 Z' fill='url(#bellGrad)' stroke='#FFB8F0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Bell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='34' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFE6FA' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Happy eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3D1A5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3D1A5C'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='40.5' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='40.5' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='48' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#FF4DB8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='48' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#FF4DB8' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Happy smile -->
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 54 56 48' stroke='#3D1A5C' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Little sparkles -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6AA'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6AA'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6AA'/>
</svg>
